h1: Discuss your cylinder or hot-water problem
title: Contact G3 Qualified Engineer London | 020 7205 4433
description: Call 020 7205 4433 or email info@g3qualifiedengineerlondon.co.uk. Share your postcode, cylinder model and symptoms to check service availability.
answer: Call 020 7205 4433 or prepare an email enquiry. Provide the postcode, equipment label and symptoms so the right service can be discussed.

sections.heading: Speak to us
paragraphs: Phone: 020 7205 4433. Email: info@g3qualifiedengineerlondon.co.uk. For an urgent discharge or electrical concern, use the telephone rather than relying on an email response. An appointment is confirmed only when availability and scope have been agreed.

sections.heading: Help us understand the equipment
bullets: Cylinder make, model and serial label if readable safely.
Whether hot water flows cold, flows weakly or does not flow.
Which normal heating source or off-peak programme is in use.
Any visible leak, discharge, light pattern or recent work.

sections.heading: What the enquiry form does
paragraphs: The form prepares a message locally and offers a copy button and an email link. You send the message using your email application. It does not secretly send a form, upload photographs or create an appointment. Photographs can be attached in your email application after you review the message.
If you do not use an email application, copy the message into webmail or call us. Contact details are not stored in browser local storage.

faqs.question: Does submitting the enquiry draft book an engineer?
faqs.answer: No. Send the email or call us; appointment details are confirmed after availability, system type and access are discussed.
